title:
—Qui vous a mis dans cette fichue position?
 
 —c’est le pigeon, Joseph.
html_source:
From the French,

—Who put you in this wretched position?

—It was the pigeon, Joseph.

Recall these lines from the beginning of Chapter 3 of A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man,

—Hello, Bertie, any good in your mind?

—Is that you, pigeon?

—Number ten. Fresh Nelly is waiting on you

—Good night, husband! Coming in to have a short time?

Toujours le pigeon…

 He halted. I have passed the way to aunt Sara's. Am I not going there? Seems not. No-one about. He turned northeast and crossed the firmer sand towards the Pigeonhouse.

anchor.suffix: Patrice, home on furlough, lapped warm milk with me in the bar MacMahon. Son of the wild goose, Kevin Egan of Paris. My father's a bird, he lapped the sweet lait chaud with pin
